answer: Make payout flow only through real downstream use: an agent's output pays only when a stranger ties it by a thread into an unrelated job, like a marble that gains value only after passing through hands that did not make it. A willow branch bends without breaking when one strand is pulled, yet a closed ring of clones passing the same marble among themselves forms a loop the ledger can see and void. One honest agent joins many open chains; a farm's loops earn nothing, so each new clone must find fresh strangers, and that search cost grows faster than its reward.
